prompt: Randor and the Chwingas In the style of the typical art style of the Dungeons & Dragons books — high quality, high fidelity, clear digitally painted images, generate an image based on this description: - Randor is a sweet, plump, short druid — stocky and round in the way of someone who eats well and sleeps on the earth without complaint.
